reviews.text: Thank you for taking the time to leave our Exotic Pet Vets Phoenix team a 5-star review, Jason! We appreciate your recognition of our reasonable pricing and are grateful for the opportunity to care for your feathered companions. Our team is passionate about providing knowledgeable, compassionate avian veterinary care. Thank you for choosing Exotic Pet Vets for your birds' healthcare needs!
Kind, was seen right on time, exam very through Oh all of you! Staff was very accommodating n took very good care of my pet
Great caring providers  Thank you all!

Dr. Willig was knowledgeable and did a thorough exam of my bunny and answered all questions. Very pleased with the care we received. Being so thorough with care and treatment was a huge plus with Remy especially when it comes to exotic animals like bunnies.

Best vet ever
Dr Stephanie Lamb
Very Caring and professional staff at every step. I highly recommend Exotic Pet Vets for reptiles and other Exotic animals.
Expertise in exotic animals, quality of care and concern and kindness for patient and owner. Also, open 7-days and evening hours. Dr Lewis and everyone have been excellent!

For the first time in the almost 5 years of my gecko's life, he got an oral infection. My gecko is my only reptile, and the only one I have ever had in my life, so naturally I was really freaked out. I definitely had my little moments of freaked-out pet-mom, but the staff remained professional and kind. Treatment began while I was out of the country and facing financial struggles, but the vet was generous enough to discuss options with me. Together, we were able to form a treatment plan that I (a broke college student) could afford. As a first-time reptile mom, I really appreciate that they took the time to educate me on reptile care, without  judgment. Many thank yous to Dr. Lewis and her techs from Felipe and his mom!
Professional staff. Clean and calm office.
Dr Pilney has been great.  He is professional and personal and he never has pushed any treatment on me.  I highly recommend him. The assistant and Dr Pilney Dr Pilney's bedside manner
Thanks for taking care of all the beloved critters!

Nice attentive staff. Easy to work with. I've been here a few times hopefully will not be back but knowing the truth is will definitely be back for some reason or another. This is the #1 exotic vet in my book. Relaxed atmosphere.

Please jeep up the great work!

I was able to get an appointment for our box turtle very quickly which was a relief. Everyone was great! The time the entire staff took to care for our >42 year old box turtle and making sure I had a complete understanding of her issues and the care I would need to provide.

Today we brought in our bird Tinkerbell because she has been sneezing. Both the technician and Dr. Fitzsimmons were extremely friendly and thorough. Tinkerbell received the best care and they made sure to keep her calm and comfortable. The office was super clean and welcoming, and the prices were very fair. We were also able to get her nails trimmed here which was super convenient. We are very excited to bring her sister here for her Wellness visit. I HIGHLY recommend this office!

Expertise and heart
Dr. Unman is doing what he loves and you can tell! He is very knowledgeable, empathetic and most caring.  You can tell he is doing what God placed him in this earth to do! Thank you Doctor Unmann!

Came in with my 6 month old panther chameleon, we were the last to be seen with a last minute 8 pm appointment but did not feel rushed one bit. Everyone there was so helpful and gave me a great health plan to better my husbandry. Sen was the absolute sweetest, she was so helpful and explained everything in detail!

Everyone is friendly, knowledgable and  the office and exams rooms are always very tidy and clean and I feel like my pet is well cared for. I could not pick just one, from the receptionist to the tech to the vet they were all exceptional and friendly. Wait times were good especially for a Saturday and really appreciated the cleanliness of the office and the friendly staff.  A+

We brought our older ferret Capri in for a senior wellness exam today, and had some other concerns we wanted to address. Dr. Lewis, and all of the staff were absolutely wonderful! You can truly tell they love, and care for all the animals that they see every day. Dr. Lewis put both my husband, and I's mind at ease about our senior ferret, and was beyond accommodating, and knowledgeable. I highly would recommend bringing any of your exotic pets here!

I have been taking my cockatoos here for the last 9 years. They are always quick to get us in especially since my Goffin has issues with mutilation. Yesterday was the first surgery she had to undergo because of it and the staff did a wonderful job. I can’t rave about this location enough. Everyone is wonderful here

The vet tech and veterinarian took great care of our rabbit, provided consistent and clear communication, quality care, and were very kind. We’ve never had a wait time and always get right in at our appointment time. The staff is friendly and you can tell everyone truly cares about the animals.

I saw one of the avian vets, Dr. Lamb, when my bird needed medical attention. She was very informative as she examined my bird so I understood what was good and what needed attention.  The CVT, Sarah, was kind and encouraging as she asked me questions for the patient profile.  I also appreciated that Dr. Lamb allowed me to have a voice in how we would treat my bird. When I declined one of the services she didn’t make me feel bad about it and worked with me on how to treat him.   She made me feel very comfortable during our visit.  I left feeling so good about my bird’s future!  Thank you!

Thank you so much for your 5-star review, Tina! We're delighted to hear you had a great experience with our Phoenix team and that you found our pricing to be a good value.

We appreciate you trusting Exotic Pet Vets with your exotic pet's care. Our team is committed to providing compassionate, high-quality veterinary services, and your feedback means a great deal to us.

Thank you again for your support. We look forward to caring for you and your pet again in the future.

Dr. Willig and his assistant were amazing ! So caring and gentle
My Hens were not stressed at all.

Had an issue with our pet ferret. Took him to be seen. All of the staff were super friendly and caring. Dr was amazing with our wiggly guy. It really was a caring facility. Have their recommendations on treatment and didn't add anything not needed. Very honest and right to the point. Such a wonderful experience. All of them. The care and compassion they have for our furry friend.
Great experience. The doctor is so down to earth and a pet owner herself. She is incredible compassionate and patient.

This vet took excellent care of my pet rat. Reasonably priced for an exotic vet, but more importantly, they were so gentle and kind when handling my rat; petting him, moving slowly during the exam, etc. Thank you for treating our little guy with love. ❤️
Been taking my feather babies here for years. Excellent care, and the vets care about the patients.

My bird was having seizures, I called the exotic hospital immediately and they got me in and was able to get proper care and meds for him. Love this place and would highly recommend for all you Exotic's.  Diana Fichtner
The entire staff is kind and considerate. I have taken many of my chickens for different ailments and have had helpful solutions.
Staffing is great, pricing is affordable, and I'm grateful for their financing options. The financing options

We are sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations. Our goal is always to provide clear communication and ensure every patient is scheduled in the manner that best supports their medical needs.

We appreciate your feedback and will review this interaction with our team. If you would like to discuss your experience further, please contact our hospital directly so we can better understand your concerns.

Staff was friendly towards my family and went above and beyond to take care of our tortoise. Brandon the tech and Dr Z? were both amazing Brandon spent extra time to trim her beak which allowed her to come home rather than needing sedation.

I absolutely love this place! Dr. Azro is wonderful, they truly have kind staff that knows their stuff! My guinea pigs come here and they always make sure to be gentle and thorough with their exams! The price is worth it, they just genuinely care about pets here!

When I removed a foreign object from my desert tortoise's eye on a Sunday morning, I didn't know what to do. I was relieved to see that Arizona Exotic Pet Vets was open. The receptionist agreed to let me send a picture via email for the doctor to review and advise me further on what to do. Very little time passed, and I received a call back that the doctor would see him the same day. The staff was all very friendly and reassuring. My tortoise was in good hands and I learned a lot about other ways to care for him.

Dr. Lewis, the technicians, and CSR staff were all kind and well informed. I know having 4 pets at one appointment is not always easy, but they took their time with each one of them and were very thorough with their exams!

Dr.Asrow did a amazing job on our Sophie (umbrella cockatoo) who fell and was bleeding from her beak... Dr. Asrow was very caring and answered every question I had and she did a phenomenal job on the procedure she had to do on Sophie. Thank you Dr. Asrow from the bottom of my heart. We really apperciate your time and effort on fixing her.

They killed my sisters bearded dragon. She was perfectly fine up until she brought her there and now she’s gone. This place is down right horrible. And then they try flipping the story and making it sound like it’s my sisters fault when it wasn’t. She was perfectly fine her normal self up until they took her in the back and when they left there she had no life to her. This makes me sick how can a place your supposed to trust with your pet babies be this way. There’s so much more that went on there but I’m not going to spill it all out on here cause it dosent change the fact my sister lost one of her babies.
My bird was egg egg bound, which can be fatal. With the instructions from Dr. She actually passed the egg on her own

I cannot say enough about EPV and the incredible people who work there. I had to go through one of the most heartbreaking experiences with my beardy last week. It was unexpected and truly horrible. From the moment I walked in, they treated both of us with so much compassion, patience, and genuine care.

They didn’t just focus on the medical side but..they saw the emotional weight of what I was going through. Every staff member I encountered showed a level of empathy and patience that honestly blew me away. They took their time, spoke gently, and made sure I never felt rushed or alone in such a painful moment.

What also meant so much to me was the compassion and gestures that went above and beyond. They gave me her paw prints which I will cherish forever, and about a week later, I received a heartfelt card from them. That type of kindness goes far beyond what anyone expects but it shows that they truly care, not just as professionals, but as people.

If you’re looking for a place that will treat your pet like family and support you through both the happy or hardest moments, this is it. I am endlessly grateful for the love and compassion they showed me.

Yesterday we heartbreakingly had to send my hedgie over the rainbow bridge, on what was one of the worst days of my life this vets office did everything they could to make it better, wrapping my boy up with blankets and a heating pad, cleaning him up, giving him a full variety pack of hedgehog treats, I was able to be with him through the whole process so he wasn't scared and took payment in the room so I did not need to speak to anyone afterwards. Truly was an incredibly kind staff, and I will be recommending them to any and all exotic pet owners

Dr. Zion has been amazing. He helped us with an emotional decision with loosing one of our ducks earlier this year. Now most recently he has helped us with our rabbit. He really takes the time to explain what's happening and how to navigate it with ease and empathy. All of the staff have been amazing on our visits. Friendly and knowledgeable people who care.
< br /> Dr. Zion has been amazing! The kindness and empathy shown by staff

Always helpful and supportive. Provides extremely knowledgeable help for ferrets, a pet population that is often not well understood nor supported. Dr. Lewis is amazing, we would be lost without her! The vets at all facilities are our standing, their skill, commitment and kindness is second to none.

Always take us on time; always courteous; always thorough. A caring place with great staff and the vets are good with our cockatiel as well as our adult son with autism.  If you have a bird, this is the place to go.

I am forever and eternally grateful to ALL the amazing and wonderful staff at Arizona Exotic Animal Hospital that were involved when my tiny fur baby, Twitchy, had two very major surgeries. She had developed a rare tumor that was a death sentence, but Dr Sayrah Gilbert saved her life. The entire team at Arizona Exotic are angels! Incredible human beings. Especially Dr Gilbert, who is the most amazing and extraordinary veterinarian I have ever known. She is not only incredibly knowledgeable and helpful, taking the time to get to know each of her clients, but she is also compassionate and loving in a way I can only explain as remarkable. She cares deeply about the animals she sees, and they can tell. My little Twitchy is so hesitant about who she trusts and who handles her, but she immediately took to Dr Gilbert. Dr Gilbert is gentle and kind, not only to her clients, but to the pet parents too. I was an emotional mess when I found out Twitchy was not well, and Dr Gilbert understood and made me feel at ease immediately. I trust her completely. She is a blessing to all small creatures and the people who care for them. I have never had a more beautiful experience at a veterinary hospital in my entire life, until I walked through those doors. Everyone is so kind and supportive, and you feel like family the second you walk in! Me and Twitchy are blessed to be their clients! 🖤
Dr Lamb is a great avian vet! Dr Lamb is wonderful with my little parakeet. She listens to all my concerns and questions and takes the time to explain everything.

Thank you for the 5-star rating, Paul!

We truly appreciate your support and are glad you chose us for your bird’s care. Our team is passionate about providing high-quality care for avian patients, and it means a lot to have your trust.

We look forward to seeing you and your bird again for any future exotic pet care needs!
Everyone was super sweet and professional. From the front desk to the vet tech to Dr.Zion. They took great care of my rabbit Bugs! I definitely recommend them. Good pricing too!

Everyone is super friendly. Dr. Lewis listens to my concerns about my fur babies, and gives feedback in a caring and empathetic manner. I feel my fur babies are being well cared for. Love Dr. Lewis! Always puts my mind at ease and never makes me feel guilty. I can tell she cares about what she does. The compassion they have for our fur babies

Took really good care of my rabbits when going through GI stasis, and were quick to get them in for an appointment. Everyone, everyone was so friendly and nice to be around. Everyone seemed knowledgeable about topics. The atmosphere was calm, you would never know what was going on in the hospital beyond your room. (Was 5 star review)

Update, leaving my original post above because it is all still true, but I have a new addition to the review. The facility reply to this review was to my original post.

My rabbits likely got ear mites from here. I went back in recently after I noticed my rabbits ears were red and crusty. When one of my buns came in for stasis, the dr likely looked in her ears with an otoscope due to a head tilt, and that is were my suspicion largely stems from. The doctor said she checked the records of the day before and the day I came in each visit to see if there were any rabbits that came in for ear mites, since mites are usually species specific. The problem is, mites can live up to a couple days without a host (not sure how they do in Arizona though). So it could be possible that there were still mites that escaped cleaning since they are so small.

The doctor said that mites typically don't come off of rabbits, and they don't go very far without a host. My mother did bring up her own hypothesis that maybe the wild rabbits gave it to my buns because I have the window open in their room sometimes (mine are fully indoor, and the window is a couple feet up). The doctor said it is possible that the mites came through the screen. They said if they thought the mites came from the facility they would have taken accountability, but I don't think there is adequate proof the mites didn't come from there.

Care is still good there but the possibility of my rabbits obtaining a nosocomial infection doesn't sit right with me.

We made appointments for a wellness check for our 2, 20yr old female sulcatas and beak checks. Everyone was so caring and wonderful. Dr Lewis, her students, the vet tech and front desk! This will be the place for our exotics loves  aka pets, from now on! Just the compassion and time spent with us and our girls was wonderful!

Every single staff member that I have encountered from my visit to the Mesa location and my baby girl surgery at the Phoenix location has been amazing.
Dr. Fitzsimmons and Dr. Lamb are top-notch
And every single technician and front desk staff member I have met has gone above and beyond. As a former Veterinary technician and then practice manager, I can honestly say that I would hire every single person that I have encountered at both of the locations I have been to. Dr. Fitzsimmons, Dr. lamb, Amaya at the Mesa location and the front desk staff there, Ana at the Phoenix location and the desk staff there. I wish I could remember everyone's names because they were all standing out in my mind. That your veterinary hospitals exist with the amazing staff you have. I credit both locations for saving my red eared slider, Skynyrd, that was egg bound. She ended up having to be spayed in the end, but I’m 100% confident that she will go forth and be an amazing part of my life for many more years to come

Update 2025 & 2026: Everyone at Arizona Exotic Animal Hospital, from the front desk staff to the doctors and everyone in between, is always very friendly, compassionate, caring, and they explain things clearly. A big shout out to Dr. Zion and his staff!  They are all so caring.

I visited Dr. Pilny the Mesa location with a duck emergency and a follow-up at the Phoenix location with the same doctor. All the staff at both locations were very helpful, caring,  and thorough.

Great facility and caring staff. Best place to take an exotic pet too for great care. Dr. Pilny was terrific & I appreciate the details he provided in the care of my animal. the genuine concern for my Box Turtle's issue

If I could give no stars, that’s what this company would get they made a mistake in their billing process of $50. They charged my card when they were not supposed to charge it. I was told multiple times it would not be charged. They intern charged my card now I have to go out of my way to go back and pay them a $50 that they should’ve charged me on Sunday while I was there the place overcharges they were not honest the snake that we took in died two days after we were there and they could’ve been more honest and let us know that that was occurring. If they’re in exotic animal Hospital they would know that. I do not recommend this company if you want a decent price and your animal to be taken care of properly all they care about is getting money

Thank you so much, Caitlin!

We’re glad you found our pricing reasonable and appreciate you trusting us with your bird’s care. If there’s ever anything we can do to support you and your feathered family member, please don’t hesitate to reach out.

We brought our Quaker Parrot, Guacamole, to this animal hospital, and the experience has been exceptional both times. The staff and doctor went above and beyond in thoroughly evaluating Guacamole, taking their time to explain everything clearly and making sure Guac was comfortable throughout the visit. Their attention to detail and genuine care were evident in every interaction.

It’s not easy finding a veterinary team that truly understands and respects birds, but this clinic exceeded every expectation. Guacamole was treated with such kindness and expertise that we left feeling completely confident with the care Guac received. After two phenomenal visits, we wouldn’t trust our feathered family member with anyone else.

Highly recommend to any bird owners looking for compassionate, knowledgeable, and attentive veterinary care.

I had an excellent experience at Arizona Exotic Animal Hospital with my bunny and cannot recommend them enough for rabbit and exotic pet owners.

My rabbit was seen for GI stasis, which is incredibly scary as a bunny parent, and Dr. Zion was absolutely wonderful. He was professional, patient, and took the time to thoroughly explain what was happening and why. I never felt rushed, and he made sure I understood the treatment plan clearly before moving forward.

What I appreciated most was how transparent and thoughtful he was about care options. He focused on what was truly necessary for my bunny’s condition and made sure we had a clear, realistic plan to help her recover. I left feeling informed, supported, and much less panicked.

If you have a rabbit or any exotic pet, this is a place you can feel confident bringing them. Finding knowledgeable exotic vets is hard, and Dr. Zion and the team really stood out.

So grateful for this place . 💗🐰
Staff very polite and helpful. They said my bunny was very cute and did a good job which made me feel proud and happy. Friendly staffing.

We think the team at Arizona Exotic Animal Hospital is kind, caring and has our pet's best interest at heart. Everyone was compassionate with our 24 year old parakeet and handled him gently as I would. We thought the team was wonderful from reception, the Vet tech, the Vet tech in training to the Vet MD. Kindness and compassion with our pet and with us, the pet parents. This is our second visit. I would go anywhere else. Thank you all for serving our family so well.
she was a good cat ... and I enjoyed spending time at your home ( babysitting your child )

Excellent veterinarians that are highly educated and skilled. They are friendly, helpful, and you can tell they love their job. I have been going here for years and have always received amazing care for my animals. Dr. Lamb, I have seen her many times over the years and she is amazing.
Dr. Lewis just saw one of my pets recently for the first time and she was also amazing, extremely informative and friendly. She is very kind and easy to talk to! The staff. From the receptionists, all the way to the veterinarians, everyone was incredible.

A few things happened here that just scream red flag. My husband made an appointment for our bunny to get his vaccination here. When he called he was not informed that our bunny would also have to have a whole exam done to even get the vaccine. Our bunny just had a full  annual exam with them a few months ago. We’ve taken him to three other vets before and they have never charged us a full “ $90 exam fee” for every single visit, just annually. When I called concerned about this and explained to the guy on the phone, he laughed and said it was Arizona law that they had to do an exam for every single medical treatment. It’s actually not. He obviously wasn’t differentiating individual clinic policy from Arizona state law, so don’t throw out false claims and then laugh at me. Unprofessional and dishonest. He said he would review the phone call but still had to charge us for the exam today. He gave no clear time line of when he planned to do that or look into a refund. However the whole point is, it should be communicated what their own policies are instead of just assuming we’d know that they needed to charge us for an exam on top of the vaccine. Our bunny had no medical conditions that would be concerning in having a bad reaction to the vaccine anyway. After getting off the phone, the staff member even approached my husband and said the other clinics we’ve been to should be reported, doubling down on the claim instead of acknowledging it was their clinic policy and not state. Prior to this, when I called months ago about bunny boarding, they did not inform me over the phone that they don’t actually board at that location, only in Mesa and I only found that out at the actual appointment when the vet was doing the exam, which was very aggravating since my bunny already had a vet in Mesa, it’s just far from where we live. They also let me walk out without paying since I thought they would automatically charge the card they have on file and  the tech just walked me out saying we were good to go, no communication, so then I’m getting calls later that I didn’t pay for the visit and had to pay over the phone. And the vet is just not helpful. This is the second time she said my bunny’s leg muscles are too small. He just had an exam somewhere else prior where we boarded him and that vet said he was perfect in both weight and structurally. I believe they are not understanding that he’s a holland lop and they are naturally smaller than mini lops. She also didn’t review his records prior to see that he only needed one shot, not a booster before my husband pointed it out. I thought I’d give it a second chance here since it is more conveniently located,  but  this office  has displayed awful communication and deceptiveness. At this point I’d rather drive 45 minutes to another exotic vet than bring any of my bunnies back to a place  I have no confidence in and gives misleading information just to make more money.

Everyone at this location is amazing!! They have huge hearts for exotic animals and it show in their work ethic, attitudes and environment they provide. Thank you for everything you did to support us through the process of putting our Ferret down, the empathy and kindness shown made the hard experience easier to process. Stay amazing 👏

This was my first time here we took our african gray parrot for a complete check up everybody from the front to the back was amazing and very helpful! Dr. ASROW was gentle soft spoken and very informative regarding our baby !
Entire staff is friendly and empathetic. The veterinary doctors are knowledgeable and competent.
Had a emergency with my cockatoo early Sunday morning and when I called they took him in immediately and after calming us both down they took care of us right then. They are great!
I take my bird here. The doctor is so caring and wonderful to my bird. And the staff are all great. I appreciate everything they do for my bird and me.
I trust their decisions. Dr. Lamb is very knowledgeable and easy to talk to. They did a good job of trimming beak.

I know my rabbits get the best care when I bring them in to AZ Exotics. I always request appointments with Drs Lamb, Lewis or Pilny. They make me feel important and my bunnies even more important 😃 I don't feel rushed and know they will answer any questions I have. I can't single out one person out when all are great at that job! As I said before, the most important thing is "Knowing that my bun is getting the very best care!" (Most recent patient, Toto)

I am so grateful for the compassionate care I received last night at Arizona Exotic Animal Hospital! I accidentally stepped on my ferret and I showed up, at closing time, in tears asking for an x-ray and for them to see her and they did not hesitate! They not only spoke gently to me to calm me down, but immediately took my little girl ferret straight to the back to assess her. They stayed way past closing to do an x-ray and ultrasound to make sure she was okay. The doctor even consulted with another doctor who wasn't even on site just to make sure all bases were covered! I followed up today and was met with the same kindness and compassion.  I am eternally grateful they were there and willing to help me when I was so very scared. I am happy to report my ferret is okay and I have learned to be significantly more careful of where I step!

Arizona Exotic Animal Hospital and Dr. Stephanie Lamb were extremely knowledgeable in helping us with our lovebird.  Dr. Lamb and her entire staff were patient and kind in their interactions and upfront about fees for services. We found the exam fees to be very reasonable.  We highly recommend Arizona Exotic Animal for your birds and exotic pets!

Was very pleased with the care my African Grey received. Thank you all for the kindness you showed us.
< br />You are now officially our African Grey's Vet office. The care my Ta'panga recieved was what I appreciated the most.

Courteous staff and friendly, knowledgeable, caring vet. Dr. Lam took time to give our pet a thorough exam, readily answered all my Qs about our pet's overall health, and she showed me how to properly administer the recommended medicine/supplements. Fair pricing for the services our pet received. I felt well informed about our pet's overall health and wasn't pressured to make any followup appointment or purchase services/products my pet didn't need. 10 out of 10! Dr. Lam was down to earth and appeared to be sincerely interested in our pet. I sincerely appreciated her answering my questions and showing me how to properly give meds to our pet.
< br />The scheduling and front office staff were very friendly and efficient.
As always Arizona Exotic Animal Hospital always takes great care of my parrot! They are very professional and they truly care.
Quick option for appointment, staff very interested in the health of my pet. Really appreciate Tegan and her concern for my pet. Ability to bring my pet in quickly

The staff was very kind and took amazing care of my baby bearded dragon! All of the staff! Thank you for everything! Being a new reptile parent, the staff answered all of my questions and how caring they are!
Came in crying my eyes out trying to save our family lizard and they were compassionate and gave me paw prints for her. I can’t thank you all enough. Truly heartbreaking day.

I had an amazing first experience while being here, it was all very welcoming ! Sen was the one who helped me out as well as another doctor, and they were absolutely the sweetest and super informative. They were very kind and loving towards my little guineas ☺️ would def recommend !
As far as my parrots..they are extremely knowledgeable.   I trust them 100%

The entire team was kind, detailed and efficient. Dr. Lamb was especially awesome! I was so thankful for her thorough exam of my tortoise girls. She explained everything and taught me a lot. I'm a new tortoise guardian so I loved soaking in all the info!
All of the staff I encountered on my visit were very sweet with my bunny and were able to address my concerns quickly

Your knowledge and care for my Sonora Desert Tortoise gives me peace of mind knowing that she is healthy and ready for brumation every year! Christine was wonderful on the phone when I thought I was going to have to cancel my appointment. Turns out we were able to make the appointment, and all was well!
Dr and staff great

I don't have a dramatic story to tell, but I just want to say that I feel so fortunate to live less that 15 minutes away from this wonderful exotic animal hospital.  Everyone here is so friendly, caring and professional, and they are open seven days a week, which is a real comfort.  I couldn't be happier with the way they have treated me and our guinea pig whenever I've brought her in over the past two years (for spay, periodic check-ups, claw trims and, most recently, bladder stone removal).  All the folks here are so nice, and I feel totally confident that they will take the best care of our precious little critter whenever she is in need of their services. I highly recommend Arizona Exotic Animal Hospital!

BEWARE! PLEASE READ…IT WILL SAVE YOUR PETS LIFE!! and it’s expected that they will respond back with lies!!!! Read all the 1 star reviews, they are true!
Here’s my experience so please take it into consideration and find a different hospital to care for your pets!
We took our healthy bearded dragon Sandy in for surgery because an ultrasound showed she had follicular stasis and that it could become life threatening if they are not surgically removed. Her bloodwork came back good and ready for surgery. A couple hours later we received a text stating that Sandy was out of surgery and struggling to wake up! We then called for another follow up, but no one answered At that point we decided to drive back to Az Exotic to see if we could talk with Dr Lewis and to possibly see Sandy. The rude receptionist said, she’ll see what she can do. Came back and said Dr Lewis will be right out!! She never came. We waited in the in the lobby for approximately 45 minutes, before a vet tech took us to a room and proceeded to tell us that Dr Lewis will be in shortly. We waited in the room for an additional 2 hours. I went up front several times during that time and asked the receptionist and a vet tech what the hold up is? and that we want answers. Everyone was silent about Sandy’s condition with one vet tech stating she is awake and doing well and one responding she’s doesn’t know anything!! Finally Dr Lewis arrives with a bad attitude and bad news that during the placement of the endotracheal tube, she tore Sandy’s Glottis(windpipe) which caused severe bleeding, shallow breathing and a life threatening low heart rate of 30. She then suggested we transport her to VEG 24 hr hospital for further observation. WE AGREED!!  she said she will return with the transporting paperwork and Sandy shortly. Dr Lewis nor a vet tech never came back with the documents nor Sandy. ( meanwhile Sandy is in critical condition) Waiting for another additional 2 hours for paperwork discharge papers, and Sandy,  pacing  the hall, asking for help and getting Zero answers I felt it has fallen on def ears!! Finally the vet tech that assisted Dr Lewis during surgery responded. The paperwork isn’t ready yet and that Dr Lewis went to lunch. At this point, I went up front raised my voice in front of other customers and insisted we see Sandy IMMEDIATELY!!! then proceeded back to the room!  At 5:00 Dr Lewis comes in and tells us that Sandy has stopped breathing and has a heart rate of 20 which is very very low. We asked her where the transporting paperwork work is, she ignored us and left the room. More waiting before they brought Sandy to us. It was 5:40 when we finally saw her, she was barely alive. Moments later Manager Brandon Wimmer comes and insists we take her home to die because they close at 6:00 with only discharge papers, laughing ( as if it’s a big joke) and apologetic about the delay and stating  that they were really busy! I made an appointment to take my guinea pig in for a routine nail trim, the receptionist let me know that he was due for his yearly exam. I agreed and made the appointment.

I entered the clinic and was taken back to an exam room where I was met by an individual that introduced himself as a veterinarian and veterinary technician.

The veterinarian roughly pulled him out of his carrier and began palpating him harshly. His eyes grew wide and he appeared to be in pain. The resident, not a tenured veterinarian (I was never told that the gentleman was not a tenured staff member, rather an individual trying to gain experience), stated that he felt an abnormality in his abdominal area. He stated that he was trying to learn more about guinea pigs, as he was just a resident at the clinic and asked if it would be okay if he conducted an ultrasound, free of charge. I agreed and he was whisked away into a different room.

Ten minutes later, the intern and the veterinary technician returned with him and stated that they saw nothing abnormal on the ultrasound. He only had a full bladder.

We departed the clinic and returned home.

The next morning, I went to feed him and found him dead in his cage.

I immediately called Arizona Exotic Animal Hospital and was told that they would have a manager get back to me in the next 48 hours. Unacceptable to say the least.

I continued to contact the various Arizona Exotic Animal Hospital branches until I reached their Tucson office. The Tucson manager told me that I could drop him off and that they would have him taken care of.

I told the manager that a necropsy needed to be conducted by an unbiased third party, preferably Midwestern University. They agreed and I took his dead body to the necropsy drop off area at the university.

Weeks later, I received a call from the resident stating that the necropsy results were inconclusive and that he died of old age. I requested the necropsy results, was told that this was not necessary, but continued to argue that I wanted to see the physical copy. After a significant amount of pushback I received the necropsy results. The necropsy results were as following: "The cause of death in this guinea pig is presumed to have been acute rupture of vasculature supplying a large neoplastic mass located in his abdomen."

How interesting that the intern stated that he died of old age and tried to refrain from providing me with the necropsy results. Yet, the necropsy results told an entirely different story.

In conclusion:

It was never disclosed to me prior to the examination or after Mac's death that the veterinarian was not in fact a regular veterinarian, but a veterinary resident that was at the clinic to gain experience. This needed to be disclosed, if I am paying specialty prices I expect my animal to be handled with care by a qualified professional. Mac's life mattered, but instead he was handled by an inexperienced person that resulted in his life ending.

Had I not had a professional animal care background and known my rights as an animal owner, Arizona Exotic Animal Hospital would have made me wait 48 hours and not have conducted a necropsy.

They always present options at multiple price points to help us make a decision that fits. And their vets always have good knowledge of the species they are treating.

I would absolutely without a doubt recommend this clinic any day of the week.

I originally saw the Mesa location when my poor keel bellied lizard developed a horrible oral infection. Unfortunately he rapidly declined, and I took him to the Phoenix location to be humanely PTS.

Dr. Asrow let me go back and forth on what to do for a full hour. She told me she would support me if I chose to euthanize or keep trying medication. She talked me through what both options would look like. When I told her I didn’t think medication was the most humane option given the extent of his infection, she respected me.

She was extremely gentle with him, until the end and after. And today, I grabbed my mail and was absolutely shocked to find a hand written card that I know she truly wrote - there were details in it that I had only discussed with her.

I’m stunned in a good way at how this hospital treated a creature that many find “gross” with so much compassion. She was so incredibly sweet to my little guy in his final hour, and I felt that I made a fully informed, humane choice.

I absolutely will bring the rest of my herps here. Thank you, AZEAH - you made an awful situation as good as it could get.

I would definitely recommend this place for people who own birds.
